summary: Security-audit regression EXECUTED (previous iteration was static-only). Backend pytest: 8/8 PASSED at /app/backend/tests/test_security_audit.py (new admin login with rotated pw, old admin pw returns 401, throwaway-email brute-force -> 429 on 6th attempt, OTP send response has NO dev_code, wrong OTP rejected, correct 123456 logs in, OTP verify caps at 5 attempts then 429, tampered POST /orders body {price:0.01,total:1} is stored with server-recomputed subtotal + express fee ₹49 + handling ₹9 and real product price). Frontend Playwright verified end-to-end: /auth email login rejects old 'Admin@123' with visible 'Incorrect email or password' error; NEW password 'Fc!LdZB5RH3sprvcI' navigates to home and localStorage sets auth_token; reload keeps user logged in (profile-admin testID present after reload) -> web token persistence WORKS. Admin Panel loads with all 8 dashboard stat cards (Orders today, Revenue today, Open orders, Low stock, Total orders, Total revenue, Products, Customers) and 6 tabs (tab-overview/orders/products/deals/pincodes/inbox). OTP screen shows 'Dev mode — use code 123456' hint, wrong code 654321 shows 'Invalid OTP', 123456 logs in and reload keeps session. COD end-to-end: OTP login -> save address (400001 default) -> add 2 products from shop -> cart pincode-check shows 'Deliver to Fort/Colaba in 6h · ₹29 fee' -> proceed-checkout -> select ck-slot-express -> place-order-btn -> 'Order placed! 🎉' success screen (Order #D7081FC8, Express, COD). Cart totals: Subtotal ₹118 + Delivery ₹49 + Handling ₹9 = ₹176 shown on checkout (server-side pricing). Subscription create from cart: subscribe-basket-btn -> /subscribe with saved address auto-selected -> sub-submit -> 'Subscription active! 🎉 First delivery on 2026-08-22' success. Only one nit: auth-page hint text still reads 'Try admin@freshcuts.com / Admin@123 for admin access' — the OLD password. Long-standing RN-web warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, defaultMuted DOM prop) remain non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2157 lines — please split into routers (auth, otp, orders, subscriptions, admin_*) before adding more surface area.

Nice: OrderIn is accepted with user-supplied subtotal/total/delivery_fee/handling_fee fields but the server overwrites them from real product data and slot fee — the tampered-price test proves it works. Consider dropping these fields from OrderIn to reduce confusion, since they are always recomputed.

rca_of_issue: No functional bugs found in this iteration. All security-audit changes (rotated admin password + old-pw lockout, login brute-force cap, no dev_code leakage in OTP response, OTP attempt cap, server-recomputed order/subscription pricing, web token persistence) are working correctly in both API and UI. The only cosmetic bug is /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx still shows a hint chip with the old 'Admin@123' credential — users would follow the hint and see 'Incorrect email or password'. Fix: remove the hint line entirely (do not expose admin credentials in UI) OR update to the new rotated password (less secure).
